component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.assets.rights
component.documentation:
An asset's rights, decided on the server for the downloads the platform's download service is asked for: the rights policies packages contribute, one per document type, and the decision the download permission and the assetRights enricher both read. Automation results, which the platform hands over without naming their document, are not decided here.
A policy says where the type keeps its rights end and its channels, and which uses of an asset each channel covers: its original, each picture view by its title, each rendition by its name, any other blob by its xpath. A use the policy does not list is refused. A use the policy marks as a preview is served whatever the rights. Any other use is refused once the rights end day has passed, in UTC, or when the asset's channels do not hold the channel that covers it. A version or a proxy has its live document's rights. A folder or a collection holding a covered document is refused its renditions, but its thumbnail. Administrators are refused like anyone else.

extension-point.name: policies
extension-point.documentation:
One rights policy per document type.
rightsEnd names a date property: its day, in UTC, is the last day the rights cover; an empty one sets no end. channels names a text or list property. The original is the blob at original's xpath, file:content when it names none, and the platform's mainBlob rendition. Each use takes either a channel or preview="true": one with both or neither is left out, so the use is refused. A policy with no rightsEnd or no channels refuses every use of its type, so a mistake refuses rather than lets through. A later policy for the same type replaces it whole, and enabled="false" removes it.
